book_metadata.author: N. Gregory Mankiw
book_metadata.source_file: N Gregory Mankiw - Principles Of Economics 2021 Cengage Learning - libgenli.pdf
book_metadata.artifact_purpose: Source-traceable, decision-oriented economics reasoning operating system for personal, creative, business, and policy reasoning.
book_metadata.personalization_boundary: The user's stability-first, debt-minimization philosophy appears only in operational-application layers and is not attributed to Mankiw.
book_metadata.copyright_handling: Records paraphrase and transform textbook foundations into reasoning metadata; the source text is not reproduced as a substitute for the textbook.

user_constraints: Prioritize financial stability
Minimize debt as much as possible
Prefer cash-funded growth
Avoid fragile or ruinous downside
Seek asymmetric upside
Take calculated risks without depending on borrowed money
Preserve optionality
Favor small experiments before large commitments
Do more with less
Use knowledge, systems, and creativity before adding capital
Protect essential living costs and emergency reserves
Distinguish productive investment from status spending
Avoid sacrificing long-term resilience for short-term acceleration
